verdict.rationale: Raygun documents an external access token for API services such as the Deployments API, dSYM, ProGuard and JS uploads, and an official MCP server exists that an agent would authenticate to. However, nothing in the pack shows these tokens can be scoped, restricted to least privilege, or issued per agent. Missing for 10: documented permission scopes or granular token permissions, per-agent or per-application credential issuance, token rotation/revocation controls, and independent corroboration.
